Based on the medical history provided, Sara and her husband both have a family history of asthma, which significantly increases the likelihood that their baby has a genetic predisposition to developing asthma or other atopic conditions. The baby’s symptoms of wheezing and shortness of breath, particularly those occurring at night, are classic indicators of respiratory distress that may be associated with early-onset asthma or reactive airway disease. These symptoms warrant immediate medical evaluation to confirm the diagnosis and establish an appropriate management plan to prevent potential complications such as severe respiratory distress or hospitalization.

Regarding your question, there are 365 days in a typical year, or 366 days in a leap year.
